I will do this plot much like last season. For beans, I do not like buying fertilizer when money is tight, and here many of us just use the little manure we have and keep cash for food and other needs. I will plant my own local seed with the other crop, weed by hand, and wait for the rains because this plot is mine and I can keep feeding it slowly with manure.
